wel.label: WEL
wel.note: IOE/WME pages listed here belong to the IOE institute / WIM faculty (canonical owners); they are skipped here so no group gets two calendars.

ioe.label: IOE
ioe.note: Enabled 2026-10-14: the winter plans live under the stale lato/ dir (.../plany/zima/ 404s), so the base is pinned, not seasonal. Transposed grid + SUBJ/type/room/alias cells convert with wlo2ics (--faculty ioe); the WME page listed here belongs to WIM and is skipped.

wcy.label: WCY
wcy.note: Enabled 2026-10-14 after a dry run from the crawling machine (plain HTTP works). The faculty shows last semester's lessons until the new plan is published; the driver skips such pages, so the calendars in the repo stay until then.

wml.label: WML
wml.note: Enabled 2026-10-13: the live index.xml is resolved via the landing page iframe (revisioned dirs); WMT-coded groups convert with wlo2ics. Watch the first runs.

wtc.label: WTC
wtc.note: Enabled 2026-10-13: crawler + PDF converter in drivers/wtc (pymupdf). The index is flat (/Plany/index.xml) and names the semester it lists; the driver files PDFs only when that is the term being refreshed. The site sits behind Incapsula.

wig.label: WIG
wig.note: Enabled 2026-10-26: Plansoft PDFs (wkhtmltopdf prints) found through the open Apache listings of the Phoca Download directories (Incapsula challenges datacenter addresses on the Joomla pages, not on these); drivers/wig rebuilds each grid from its ruling lines into the Plansoft table wlo2ics converts (pymupdf). dirs names the programme directories (the listing above them is hidden; their stacjonarne/niestacjonarne/drugistopien subdirectories are walked): a new programme on rozklady-zajec is found by the census (landing, walked by the runner fleet.json gives census: wig, at most daily; the directories it finds are crawled from then on and logged, to be added here). On 2026-10-26 only 'Bud. dróg i mostów' had no directory yet. WIG..BW groups are also listed by WEL, whose copy is fresher, so WEL stays their owner and they are skipped here, as are PDFs that are not group plans.
